description: Application for a non-material amendment following a grant of planning permission 23/02912/FUL (Demolition of the existing dwelling and erection of five detached two storey (plus basement) houses, together with the provision of car parking spaces, refuse/cycle storages, landscaping treatment including alteration and removal of trees, alterations to access arrangements and other associated works) granted on 12.08.2024.Amendment sought: Minor adjustments / amendments reducing window widthsMinor amendment to the curtain wall system window profileRear entrance door height and width reducedSide entrance door height reduced and side panel omittedRooflights amendedMinor amendments to roof junction to proposed south west elevationLightwell balustrades amended to be glass inlieu of timberMinor amendments to bay window; aluminium cladding lowered/dropped and cantilever has been omittedMinor amendments to windows facing central lightwell
